description: Salam and El Hibaoui publish electricity-consumption observations for three distribution networks in Tetouan, northern Morocco. UCI lists 52,417 instances with a timestamp every ten minutes, weather variables and three zone-level consumption targets. Inputs include temperature, humidity, wind speed and two diffuse-flow variables. The CSV is freely accessible under CC BY 4.0 and supports the authors’ power-consumption prediction study. Spatial coverage is the three city distribution zones, but the landing page does not state their boundaries, target units or the calendar observation range. Those omissions are material limitations for physical calibration or matching another time series. Simulation uses include comparing multizone load forecasters and studying weather-conditioned demand, after checking units and dates in the source documentation or eventual payload. It complements data-open-power-system-data, whose electricity series operate at different spatial scales. The provider dates the dataset citation to 2018 and its UCI donation to 2023; neither date was substituted for the observation year. No CSV was downloaded.
